notes.title: The Idiots' Fantasy Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Idiots![/h1]
[h2]The Fantasy Had Just begun and with it a new update as well as a 20% discount![/h2]

I thank all the people who had helped me develop Idiots' Fantasy through the last year and played the Demo. First and foremost I'm going to state that Idiots' Fantasy is not going to lose support and is going to receive updates until the studio dies. After a year these updates will get less frequent but you can hold me for my word that they will never cease to appear.
Now with the 0.3 Idiots' Fantasy Update!

[h3]Post run progression[/h3]
Now you can progress outside the runs by buying new items in Charlstone's shop which is just right off the Main menu.
[list]
[*] Give achievement for unlocking a new weapon
[*] Create a new "Charlstone's " shop in the Main menu
[*] Create a new currency for the post-progress "Supreme Gold"
[*] Stop the locked items from appearing
[*] Have the bosses and mobs drop the supreme gold
[*] Save supreme gold between run
[*] Create 45 Unlock Achievements
[/list]

[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now press ESC or options or "view" on the controllers to open the mini-menu.
[*] The Character buttons in the main menu are now locked to one click per entrance so you won't get irritating situations.
[*] Fixed a few colliders in the main menu.
[*] Now if you doge when walking your direction won't be reset.
[*] The road generation had been reworked so now it doesn't bug and fits with the environment (in a nutshell the roads are now drawn rather than created when the map is being built).
[*] Added 5 different gold sprites
[*] Added particles on gold collection
[*] Made gold come to the player
[*] Added Screen Shake on gold collection
[*] Fixed Minimap Roads
[*] Changed Castle Road Walls
[*] Improved arrow speed & Accuracy 
[*] Fixed Volume Sliders
[*] Changed Test volume sound to "Pop"
[/list]

I'd like to than Shakey for pointing out the issues with the game that had been fixed in this update.

Have a prosperous day
Leon

[h2]Welcome to the Chests & Damage Demo 1.1 update![/h2]

Just like it should be in an Idiots' Fantasy... Idiotic. The damage UI has also received a strong rework, there's now a flash bar, bar shake and all parts of the bar work faster now also damage number has been added with and Boss bar that will appear at the bottom of the screen (like in dark-souls). To top it all off all damage has now random additional damage of - (Damage * 10% + 5).

notes.title: Idiots' Fantasy Demo 1.0 - Quality
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there![/h1]

[h2]This is the 1.0 update for the Demo of Idiots' Fantasy![/h2]
We've come a long way and I'm proud of the point we arrived at.
As you might have noticed lately game development shifted towards polishing the game rather than adding new features/content. 
That is because I was dissatisfied with the game's lackluster state. 
Now the game is in a far better position, the original quality goal for this game is [i][b]GUNGEON[/b][/i] and I mean it! So don't think that this is the end, the game still has around 50% of its release polish. 
And content too!
The release state game will have 5 times of what is now in the game! 

This update seems small compared to the [b]1.0[/b] mark but it's impactful on the gameplay and overall game feel.

[list]
[*] Have the bean guy run rather than dance in loading
[*] Have the thrown equipment temporarily disappear from the hand
[*] Projectiles should stop on objects
[*] Projectiles should have a (piercing ability) statistic
[*] Projectiles should attach to objects at which their ( piercing ability ) hits 0
[*] Have the arrow appear in the bow when charging
[*] A particle effect around ranged attacks
[*] Make an effect similar to meteorites entering the atmosphere
[*] Projectiles should stay in-game as only graphics after being used up
[*] Fix the disappearance delay
[*] Ranged attack should create a particle effect as they dig into the target
[*] Ranged attack should continue moving for 0.1s as they dig into the target
[*] Unify the attack trigger system
[*] Fixed Poking for the Goblin
[/list]

I also added [b]Vignette[/b], which honestly adds crazy amounts of quality to the game. [i](You'll see it after playing)[/i]

Have a prosperous day!
Leon [i](I'm going to use my actual name cause I'm proud of my game from now on)
[/i]
